_note: This is the ORIGINAL Phase 0 starting point the design doc calls for: every category at Propose, before any autonomy was granted. It exists for audit trail purposes -- to show a reviewer/auditor that autonomy was granted incrementally and deliberately, not that the system started with Auto decisions already baked in. The live matrix your automation actually reads is Phase1-SafeAutoRemediation/autonomy-matrix.json (schemaVersion phase1-v1), which reflects the Phase 1 approval that came after this baseline was reviewed.

approvalHistory.summary: Initial baseline: every category Propose. No Auto anywhere.
Storage/KeyVault/AppServices/Defender promoted to Auto per environment, per the Phase 1 build. See Phase1-SafeAutoRemediation/autonomy-matrix.json.
